Thank you for your feedback. We’re sorry to hear that you decided to leave after having a drink.

However, we would like to clarify a few points, as your review may give future guests an inaccurate impression of our restaurant.

Our current menu has been updated on both Google and our website, and the menu currently offered at the restaurant is also our latest menu. It appears that you may have been referring to an older menu from around two years ago, which is no longer available.

Our menu has intentionally been simplified so that we can focus on the quality of our steaks and the dining experience. When you visited, our staff also suggested a steak with tiger prawns as an option. This is a classic “surf and turf” combination, and we were simply offering it as a suggestion based on your preferences.

Of course, you are completely free to decide what you would like to order, and we respect your decision to leave. However, we hope future guests will have the correct information about our current menu and understand that we have not misrepresented or hidden our menu.

We always welcome genuine feedback and are happy to improve where necessary. We simply wanted to clarify the situation for the benefit of anyone reading this review.

Hoi An Steakhouse Riverside — A Genuine Standout
Mar 2026 • Couples
We came for the setting, we stayed for the food. Hoi An Steakhouse Riverside delivered on every front — and then some.

We worked through three starters before sharing a steak and a duck main, paired with a bottle of wine. 

Portions are generous — our tip: order two mains between two and share, so you get to try more of the menu. The steak was cooked perfectly — the kind of quality that makes you stop mid-conversation. 

The duck held its own too, which is saying something when you're at a steakhouse.

Tucked away from the chaos of the Old Quarter, the riverside setting gives you breathing room alongside real atmosphere — calm, elegant, and easy to linger in.

Service was attentive, warm, and never hovering. Staff read the table well, which is rarer than it should be.

As experiential travel specialists, we're selective about where we send our clients. This one made the list without hesitation. 

Whether you're planning a romantic dinner, a business meal, or you're simply a food-focused traveller after a proper evening out — Hoi An Steakhouse Riverside is one of the best dining experiences Vietnam has to offer.

Very impressive.
